title: Third Eye and Life
author: Nicole Campbell
description: Third Eye and Life by Nicole Campbell, a short modern self-help guide promising to 'discover how to activate your Third Eye and manifest your desires effortlessly into your life while boosting your inner power and connecting with the Universe's energy'. It explains the third eye or ajna chakra, its traditional associations with intuition and the pineal gland, signs of an awakening third eye, and practical methods for opening it, including meditation, aromatherapy and essential oils, crystals, diet and visualisation. It ties the practice to manifestation and law-of-attraction techniques for wellbeing, relationships and success, and includes a related bonus section ('Third Eye Code'). Accessible and non-academic, it represents contemporary popular chakra and manifestation literature.
